summary: Master the essentials of Pension Fund Auditing & Compliance with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with best practices for success in the field.
lede: Auditing pension funds involves reviewing governance, controls, records and compliance with relevant requirements. This course is for professionals involved in pension fund auditing, governance, supervision or administration, and covers planning risk-based audits, testing investment, benefit and member-record controls, and documenting findings to support corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in pension fund governance, auditing, supervision, or administration, who regularly need to test compliance and controls.
audience: Pension fund administrators and operations managers
Compliance officers and risk managers in pension
Investment and portfolio oversight teams for pension
Regulators and supervisory staff for pensions
modules: Foundations of Pension Fund Governance and Auditing
Regulatory and Legal Frameworks for Pension Funds
Planning and Scoping a Pension Fund Audit
Internal Controls in Pension Fund Administration
Auditing Investments and Compliance with Investment Mandates
Data Integrity, Member Records, and Benefit Accuracy
Fraud Risks, Ethics, and Forensic Considerations in Pension Funds
Developing Actionable Audit Findings and Recommendations
Embedding Continuous Compliance and Governance Best Practices
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of pension fund operations and governance. Prior experience in auditing or compliance is beneficial but not mandatory.
